shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright vertical slab/pillar
figures stacked vertically on a single field
justification: Both surfaces are upright fields bearing low-relief figures arranged one above another, and both include quadruped/animal-like forms in profile, but that is about as generic as a correspondence can be. A shows only two or three isolated, schematic animals in profile on a blank ground, whereas B shows a composed scene of standing human figures flanking an offering table beneath a rayed disc, over dense registers of sign-like inscription — different subject matter, relationships and rendering conventions entirely.
